verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server for Atlas. An llms.txt file and markdown docs are adjacent AI-readability features, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
